scientific_object: Whether a package-wise adaptive skill scheduler is invariant to semantically redundant or overlapping skill representations when released skill validators define overlapping support on real benchmark tasks.

selection.adapter: Only for rows whose original answer is a length-1 list containing one dict, copy the row and replace answer with that sole dict so the released validate_sample interface can parse the unchanged ground-truth tool call. Do not change system, user, tool name, or parameters.

representation_counterfactual.operation: For each released skill independently, append one exact copy with the same name, description, example, added_iteration, and stats but a fresh ID. Recompute the author sampling weights. The semantic support represented by the original+clone is by construction unchanged relative to the unsplit skill.
representation_counterfactual.observable: relative increase in normalized probability mass assigned to the exact-equivalence class {original, clone}

strongest_same_information_reduction.name: intentional hierarchical taxonomy / harmless overlap
strongest_same_information_reduction.wins_if: released validators have little real benchmark overlap, or exact semantic ID-splitting leaves normalized semantic-class sampling mass unchanged
strongest_same_information_reduction.candidate_survives_only_if: real benchmark overlap is broad and package-wise sampling is materially representation-sensitive even under exact semantic equivalence

next_if_positive: Run current-source novelty/reduction review, then seek an independent second-domain/public-system replication and a decision-changing dynamic falsifier before Paper Design.
next_if_negative: Kill semantic-multiplicity candidate on Skill-SP; do not rescue by generating synthetic overlap tasks or changing validators.
